key_insight: Training language models on structured experimental evidence helped OpenPerov reason about perovskite solar cells and guide a contact design that achieved 27.05% efficiency.
engineering_relevance: Evidence-grounded AI could help engineers select materials, design discriminating experiments and optimize solar-cell performance and stability.
method: Reconstructed expert-calibrated evidence records from 4,035 articles, linking strategies, controls and observations to mechanisms.
Adapted OpenPerov using structured evidence and refined selected responses through evidence retrieval.
Experimentally tested an AI-selected K-based self-assembled monolayer analogue against the expert-preferred Na analogue.
evidence_signal: On the 800-question PSM-Bench, OpenPerov Flash ranked first among 13 closed-book systems; experimentally, devices using the selected contact retained 96.74% of initial efficiency after 1,000 hours of dark thermal ageing at 85°C.
watch_item: The reported stability test used dark thermal ageing, so it does not establish durability under continuous illumination or outdoor operation.
paper_title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
